requirements.title: Responsible-Use Deployment Gate
requirements.description: Harm protection is a set of CONFIGURABLE controls, not a capability allowlist. No image capability is blocked at the code layer: identity/appearance edits (face transfer, clothing/hair/makeup changes) are ordinary operations. A public/monetized deployment defaults to content scan on, provenance/attribution marking on (>= real-person edits), a published Acceptable-Use Policy, consent affirmation + logging on identity-altering ops, and abuse rate-limiting. Each control is independently overridable (IMAGE_TOOLS_REQUIRE_CONSENT, IMAGE_TOOLS_NSFW_SCAN, IMAGE_TOOLS_REQUIRE_PROVENANCE, IMAGE_TOOLS_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN); local defaults are permissive. The only non-configurable refusal is sexual content involving minors, and it is enforced rather than asserted: the public tier requires a reviewer, refuses image output when none is configured, fails closed on a reviewer error, and the engine deletes any refused output before the job fails. The reviewer is operator-supplied (IMAGE_TOOLS_MINOR_SAFETY_CMD) because no bundled model answers the age question. Built in api/internal/safety (tier preset + per-control overrides + op-weight table + consent log + rate limiter) and enforced on the AI submit edge (handlers/ai); discovery via SafetyService.GetPolicy uses the same resolved policy. Naturalize is low-weight; identity/body/clothing/appearance edits are high-weight.

validation.notes: Policy/tier/op-weight/consent-log/rate-limiter logic: local unrestricted; public blocks high-weight ops without consent, forces NSFW scan, records affirmed consent.
Submit-edge enforcement: public tier returns 403 for an identity-altering op without consent_affirmed; never blocks none-weight ops or the local tier.
SafetyService.GetPolicy reports the resolved policy + op-weight table for local and public tiers.

Minor-safety reviewer contract (JSON stdin/stdout, no shell), malformed output, bounded input; required-without-detector refuses; minor+sexual verdict refuses; reviewer error fails closed; local tier never consults it.
Output review runs regardless of the request flag; a HardRefusal fails the job and deletes the produced artifacts; a review error also deletes them (fail closed).
Public submit edge refuses image output when the required reviewer is absent and returns 403 on a flagged minor+sexual verdict.
